summary:
I've been rebuilding image generation for Keikochō, a Japanese-learning app I built for myself, after realizing the original art (anime girls, mostly) was an odd fit for a middle-aged guy's study app. The interesting part wasn't the prompts, it was catching a bug where a whole rendering pipeline had been silently skipping a style layer — every image sent to the hosted model was going out without the inking and color rules I thought I'd applied, and nobody noticed for weeks because a related casting fight got blamed on the wrong cause instead. Fixing it took an A/B render at a fixed seed to actually prove which version was wrong.

I also spent time on the conversation engine underneath the app — the part that runs the chat-practice mode. Measuring real usage turned up that most of the "twelve possible answers" scenarios I'd built were resolving to the same one answer almost every time, so the practice wasn't actually testing anything. That's now driving a rewrite of how each character's personality is defined, so the answer space is actually unpredictable instead of just decorative.

On the infra side, I run a personal automation agent (a Hermes-based assistant) across a few home servers, and one of the messier bugs there was a duplicate background service both trying to bind the same port — one worked, one silently crash-looped hundreds of thousands of times without anyone noticing, because the working copy hid the failure completely. Tracked it down through the process's control group rather than trusting `systemctl status`, which reported clean.

Smaller things: exposing a read-only media search tool to a browser-based tool client, where the real fix was serving it same-origin instead of fighting three separate CORS failure modes one at a time; and a Slack integration that went dark for a week because a reconnect bug in a library left no error signature at all when it was healthy, so the usual "watch for errors" health check couldn't tell the difference between working and dead.

highlights.oneLiner: Found a rendering pipeline silently skipping a style layer; fixed with fixed-seed A/B renders
Usage data showed multi-choice prompts collapsing to one answer; rewriting personality logic
Traced a silent duplicate-service crash loop via cgroups after systemctl reported clean
Fixed a browser tool client by serving same-origin instead of chasing three CORS failure modes
